transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, what brings me in is... I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's really just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I guess I've lost some weight, too, because my pants are just hanging loose on me now.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight or feel that your body is larger than it really is?

No, it's not that. I'm not worried about getting fat or anything like that. I know I'm losing weight, and I definitely don't think I'm big. I just... I just don't really have any appetite or interest in eating right now.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed most of the day lately?

Yeah... yeah, I have. Most days, actually. I wake up and there's just this... this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It's like nothing good is waiting for me anyway, so I just want to keep my head down. That's pretty much how my whole day goes.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I'd say so. I used to really like going for walks down by the lake, and I'd spend time working on my little model kits. But lately... I don't even touch them. They just sit there on the table, and I look at them like they belong to somebody else. I just don't care about doing any of it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this depressed?
It's been... I'd say about five months now. This depressed spell has just been hanging over me for that whole time.
Have you been having thoughts about dying or killing yourself?

No, I haven't. I mean, I feel awful, and I don't really care about much right now, but I haven't thought about actually ending it or anything like that. Just... just trying to get through the days, I guess.
How has your energy been during these five months?

My energy's been pretty much gone. I just... I don't have any. Even doing little things, like taking out the trash or just coming here to the clinic, it feels like it's too much. It's just really hard to move. It feels like my arms and my legs are full of wet sand.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions during this five-month period?

Yeah, I have. I can't really keep my mind on things. Like if I try to look at forms or my bills, I just... I can't focus on them at all. My brain just won't do it. 

And making choices is really hard right now, too. I'll go to the store and just stand there, completely stuck over really small things. Like, I can't even figure out what can of soup to buy. I just stare at the shelf and can't pick one.
How has your sleep been during these five months?

It's been really bad. I just... I can't seem to get any decent rest. Lately, I'll go to bed and just lie there for hours, just staring at the wall, unable to drift off. Or I'll finally fall asleep and then wake up way before the sun's even up, and I just can't get back to sleep after that. And honestly, even when I do manage to get some sleep, I still wake up feeling completely worn out. It's like I didn't sleep at all.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to work, manage responsibilities, or take care of yourself?

It's... it's interfered a lot. Since this got really bad, I just haven't been able to keep up with basic errands the way I used to. I've actually needed my relatives to step in and help me out with a lot of things. They've had to help me with money, and giving me rides, and... dealing with my paperwork. I just can't manage it on my own right now.
Have you been able to manage your basic personal hygiene, such as bathing, on your own?

Yeah, I can... I can still do that on my own. I mean, I don't need anyone to help me take a shower or get dressed or anything like that. My family helps with all the outside stuff, but... I can handle washing up by myself.
